description: This source file contains a comprehensive suite of unit tests for the 'get_model_info()' function within the litellm project. It covers various scenarios including model name parsing, provider-specific behavior, regional model handling, interactions with external models (e.g., Ollama, Bedrock, Huggingface), and enforcement of model whitelisting for Bedrock models. The file also demonstrates usage of mocking, environment manipulation, and parameterized tests to ensure robustness of the model information retrieval functionalities.
